kitDescription: Phantom (Treasure) is a Water AR Burst-III attacker built around a thief loop: her hits apply a 5-second Calling Card status to the target, and every hit on a card-carrying target grants her a 1-round Attack Damage ▲75.17% buff. She also builds Thief's Dagger stacks (Hit Rate ▲25.75% each, max 3) — one at the start of each firing cycle and one every 30 hits from her treasure — and at 3 stacks she consumes them for an 84.33% additional-damage hit plus a 250% distributed-damage hit to all enemies, while banking a permanent Distributed Damage ▲12.86% stack (max 3) that her own burst resets. Every 10 normal attacks she self-buffs ATK ▲85.12% for 5s and Distributed Damage ▲31.92% for 10s. Her burst deals 1457.28% of final ATK as distributed damage to all enemies, applies Damage Taken ▲18% for 30s if the stage target is Fire Code, and expands her own magazine by 50% for 10s.

Not a driver divergence.

WIRING-REPAIRED run (assertions untouched): 5 reds remain — (i) Thief's Dagger shape: blind expects vanilla hitRatePct 25.75 maxStacks:3/5s-expiry; driver ships a live perResource pool (documented: the 5s decay never binds, consume pre-empts it); (ii) Attack Damage durationShots===1: blind asserts the kit-literal 1; driver ships :2 as the documented engine-order compensation (⚑2, reconciled with S2b); blind's wall-clock counterfactual ties the driver total (no discrimination power); (iii) 84.33 test passes a SimResult where an OverrideFile is expected (test artifact, RECON_ERROR); (iv)+(v) two tests filter burstCast on e.unitSlug but the SimEvent field is e.slug (test artifact, RECON_ERROR).
GREEN after repair: the hitCount:10 ATK 85.12/5s + distributed 31.92/10s line (real blind-vs-driver convergence) and the non-vacuous inertness assertion.

verdictRationale: No undocumented REAL-GOTCHA exists: every divergence between the prose and the driver's encoding is recorded in the override's note/caveats/unmodeled with an estimate and a recipe, and the four gotcha-class items (durationShots:2 compensation, self-extending CC window, unmodeled Removes-Calling-Card, inert DEF▼ magnitude) are all documented, low-severity, and damage-small by arithmetic rather than by fitting. The blind re-derivations partially converged: S5's pristine run is red purely from its own harness-wiring artifacts (onEvent at the wrong level, wrong OverrideFile shape, SimResult-as-override, unitSlug-vs-slug), and after a wiring-only repair it converges GREEN on the hitCount:10 line and non-vacuous inertness — the remaining reds are documented driver enactment choices (perResource pools, durationShots:2) that S2b had already reconciled, not fresh finds. S6 independently re-derived the same resource-pool consume architecture, the hitCount:10 block, the distributed burst nuke, and the identical verbatim skip of 'Removes Calling Card', but the driver is strictly ahead of both blind agents: S6 missed the treasure every-30 Dagger grant (3× too-slow cadence), missed the burst vuln and max-ammo lines, and declared the burst-reset of the 12.86% stacks unmodelable where the driver modeled it exactly — all blind-side RECON_ERRORs corroborated against the prose. Discrimination holds on the driver's own 25-assertion suite (two-sided P4 gate, P7 oscillation reset, P10 byte-identical Iron inertness, P3 2× treasure cadence, P2 flat-max over-credit). For GO nothing must change; the residuals the owner should spot-check are precisely the same-model-blind spots: S2b/S5/S6 all ran kimi-k3 so their agreements prove stability, not correctness — specifically (1) the sim.ts:2913/2973 dispatch-ordering citation underwriting durationShots:2, (2) the perResource/resourceGate/distAmp-reset machinery validated only by the driver's own suite (no blind agent reproduced it), (3) the treasure-prose provenance of skill1 bullet 3 (the datamined skill1_detail carries only 3 bullets), and (4) the unverified ⚑5 cadence tuple (RoF 720/reloadFrames 141) that the whole once-per-magazine consume cadence derives from.
